analysis.executiveSummary: This proposed offer sends Tucker Kraft (TE, GB) to Ravens Regime in exchange for tight end Isaiah Likely (TE, NYG) and running back Kyle Monangai (RB, CHI). For All Hail King Jesus, the transaction achieves the stated goal of balancing the roster by upgrading the starting RB2 slot from Zach Charbonnet (49.5 C-AVI) to Monangai (57.4 C-AVI) while preserving high-end tight end utility with Dallas Goedert (82.5 C-AVI) starting and Likely entering the FLEX rotation. For Ravens Regime—a fellow Playoff Push contender—consolidating two sub-70 C-AVI depth starters into an elite, younger TE/FLEX centerpiece in Kraft (+10.1 C-AVI FLEX upgrade over Likely) delivers a net +6.1 starting lineup C-AVI improvement, making this a mutually beneficial construction with high acceptance probability.

submitted.summary: Trading Tucker Kraft for Isaiah Likely and Kyle Monangai efficiently solves All Hail King Jesus's biggest structural bottleneck at RB2 while leaving starting TE Dallas Goedert intact. Ravens Regime gains the single best asset in Kraft, net-improving their starting FLEX slot by +10.1 C-AVI and overall starting lineup by +6.1 C-AVI.

analysis.executiveSummary: All Hail King Jesus proposes sending starting RB D'Andre Swift to Ravens Regime in exchange for Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Kaytron Allen, and a 2028 2nd-round pick. While Ravens Regime would eagerly accept this trade to secure a prime RB1/RB2 anchor alongside Derrick Henry, the construction is strategically damaging for All Hail King Jesus. Giving up Swift (78.2 C-AVI) drops All Hail King Jesus's RB1 position down to Croskey-Merritt (53.4 C-AVI), creating a significant 24.8 C-AVI drop in its starting lineup during an active playoff push in a 16-team league. AVI recommends revising the offer to send bench receiver Deebo Samuel instead, or requiring high-upside WR Carnell Tate if Swift remains in the deal.
